entries.heading: Senior Perception Engineer | Ironclad Robotics | 2021 – Present

items.text: Architected multi-task 2D/3D object detection and panoptic semantic segmentation networks in PyTorch for warehouse autonomous forklifts, achieving 94.6 mAP@50 on pallet and dynamic pedestrian classes.
Quantized YOLOv8 and SegFormer models to INT8 with post-training calibration and compiled custom TensorRT plugins on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, hitting 60 FPS inference under a 22W thermal budget.

Implemented zero-copy ROS 2 Humble C++17 lifecycle nodes over CycloneDDS and a Python utility pipeline for retrieving calibration frames from onboard ring buffers, streaming synchronized RGB-D point clouds at 30 Hz.
Orchestrated multi-node PyTorch DDP distributed training across 32 AWS EC2 p4d GPUs and curated 1.8M annotated LiDAR-camera frames stored on S3.
Adapted a DINOv2 ViT-L vision foundation model using LoRA adapters to detect shrink-wrap tears and damaged pallet stringers from 3,000 labeled warehouse images.

Developed automated extrinsic alignment routines and an Extended Kalman Filter blending 3D laser rangefinder sweeps, stereo depth frames, and inertial angular rates to hold sub-2cm pose accuracy during wheel slip.

Built an automated hardware-in-the-loop regression harness in Jenkins using Gazebo and NVIDIA Isaac Sim to benchmark obstacle avoidance trajectories across 500 domain-randomized warehouse lighting scenarios.
Integrated ByteTrack and Kalman-filter multi-object tracking in C++ to maintain persistent worker IDs through 3-second racking occlusions.

Spearheaded on-site war rooms with electrical, embedded firmware, and motion-planning engineers to diagnose intermittent CAN-bus drops and safety curtain interlock / collision guardrails stalls, cutting fleet MTBF incidents by 52%.
Implemented GPU-accelerated ICP scan matching and stereo VIO state vectors in C++/CUDA, reducing loop-closure drift by 44% across 10,000m² fulfillment centers.
Partnered with warehouse operations leads and product managers to translate ambiguous dock-unloading workflows into concrete perception specs and ship updated pallet-slot detectors.
Built fleet telemetry triggers that automatically uploaded high-entropy model disagreement clips from deployed robots to the labeling queue, cutting manual annotation spend by 35%.

Trained Mask R-CNN instance segmentation models in PyTorch to localize wind-turbine blade delamination and lightning strike pits from drone imagery.
Mentored 2 junior engineers through weekly reinforcement of modern C++ memory-safety guidelines and deterministic unit testing.

Fused dual 24V/12V power rails and hardware GPIO trigger lines on a custom Jetson carrier board to synchronize four-camera global shutters within 150 microseconds.
